title: Creamy Italian Slow Cooker Chicken
description: This creamy Italian slow cooker chicken is a yummy dish to serve over thick pasta, such as egg noodles or farfalle. The sauce has a hint of sherry.
ingredients: 4 (4 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1.5 (.7 ounce) packages dry Italian-style salad dressing mix

steps.text: Rinse chicken, and pat dry with paper towels. Place chicken breasts into a slow cooker, and drizzle melted butter all over chicken breasts, lifting them up to allow butter to flow underneath the chicken. Cover the cooker, set to High, and cook until tender, 4 to 5 hours. With a metal spatula, chop up chicken into bite-size pieces in the slow cooker.

Place cream cheese, cream of chicken soup, Italian salad dressing mix, and sherry into a saucepan over medium heat, and bring to a boil, constantly stirring until cream cheese has melted and sauce is well combined. Pour sauce over chicken in the slow cooker; cover, and cook on High until the flavors have blended and the sauce is bubbling, about 30 more minutes.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make creamy Italian Slow cooker chicken, a quick and easy dish that could become a favorite for simple weeknight dinner preps. The rich sauce features cream of chicken soup, cream cheese, and Italian style salad mix, so it’s filled with flavor. Plus, you can lower the calories by substituting low fat cream cheese and soup. Serve this versatile dish over rice or egg noodles to make a complete meal.
